What’s in Estre Ambiental Inc – Ordinary Shares (NASDAQ:ESTR) After Decline in Shorted Shares? Posted by Clifton Ray 49 pm
The stock of Estre Ambiental Inc – Ordinary Shares (NASDAQ:ESTR) registered a decrease of 5.05% in short interest. ESTR’s total short interest was 139,100 shares in January as published by FINRA. Its down 5.05% from 146,500 shares, reported previously. With 5,000 shares average volume, it will take short sellers 28 days to cover their ESTR’s short positions. The short interest to Estre Ambiental Inc – Ordinary Shares’s float is 0.78%.
The stock decreased 9.09% or $0.23 during the last trading session, reaching $2.3. About 19,007 shares traded or 33.69% up from the average. Estre Ambiental, Inc. (NASDAQ:ESTR) has declined 70.50% since January 8, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 70.50% the S&P500.
Estre Ambiental, Inc. provides waste-related and environmental services for municipal, commercial, and industrial clients in Brazil and Latin America. The company has market cap of $104.96 million. The firm operates through four divisions: Collection & Cleaning Services, Landfill, Oil & Gas, and Value Recovery. It currently has negative earnings. The Collection & Cleaning Services segment is involved in the industrial collection from large business generators, as well as local household collection.
